LastModified.description: Date and time at which the object was uploaded.

ChecksumCRC32.description: The Base64 encoded, 32-bit CRC32 checksum of the part. This checksum is present if the multipart upload request was created with the CRC32 checksum algorithm. For more information, see Checking object integrity in the Amazon S3 User Guide.
